craft_notes: Sthāyin: śeṣavṛtti unit 55. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 8. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: By that indeed should do worship he thus Śambhu's decision; of sādhakas of desirers of enjoyment rule bound by niyati.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tenaiva kuryātpūjāṃ sa iti śambhorviniścayaḥ sādhakānāṃ bubhukṣūṇāṃ vidhirniyatiyantritaḥ
